# Fixed literal background with bounded supplied controls and positive waits

**Current status: conditional scientific source and source-only assembly accepted; this publication rendering and driver await separate exact root review.** Root accepted assembly c549b31a4cab81efd2f26cd037666a1f357d746280f11ac6850c4ede67173b34 under FIXED_BACKGROUND_CONTROL_ASSEMBLY_ROOT_ACCEPTANCE.json SHA 75343193a4362c96d2d712084581eefc1b2ea550b03816e6fc29760cb5ba0473, with complete composition review 01e09f4fbc01b1b8981fab3b9404c3ddb10c0259f48264ce81fb8bf9ac12d247. Root accepted the unchanged proof `7c1c3bfd1787a1041c9c58d5f7c2a7a576892ce6a554b7c9cecbc61daa74453f` without mathematical repair at `2026-10-14T13:07:10.890684+00:00`, in `FIXED_BACKGROUND_CONTROL_ROOT_ACCEPTANCE.json` SHA `d14edde4e53c0ae04e2dabd868fec51ed566db415cb3841cdbf97fb0412ad093`. Root review `a073cb3f6b6bdca90b32cc24c43b04e001d2e81fe83940e989e82ea9b5427ced` and separate review `fe3caa8302e272cbce29b0ee8965de25427fa06e508db16757b54fb517b0420a` support that disposition. This is not retained status, an audit verdict, acceptance of a publication driver or physical realization. The original body below retains its historical provisional and exposure wording unchanged.

Fix the literal L4 Hamiltonian `H=λN_full+B` on the original 1344 active physical qubits and extend it by identity to the other factors in the ordinary 64³ box. Its coefficients, signed terms, periodic seam interactions, unused-link level and scalar remain fixed. The theorem supplies a finite, phase-exact approximation of either accepted target word by bounded one-site/ordinary-neighbor additive controls and nonnegative H-only waits. It neither attenuates H nor supplies −H, cancellation or drift-off intervals. Added controls have ordinary-neighbor support; the full background retains its original high-arity periodic terms.

The full-space sufficient bounds are `h=6080Λ+2112J_b≥‖H‖` and `ℓ=166Λ+13J_b` for the whole-term per-site norm, with certified rational Λ≥λ and J_b≥J. A supplied positive norm margin c satisfies `ℓ+c≤J_cap`. This is a control-budget premise: individual signed Hermitian logarithms and H itself need not be positive. For the literal finite gate alphabet, `e^(−iL_g)=g`, `‖L_g‖≤π`, including their scalar phases. Set `τ=4/c`, `K_g=L_g/τ`, and choose the cell parameters in the unchanged proof.

For M ideal primitives and `0<e≤1`, the source takes `m≥max(1,ceil(2Mτ²hc/e))`, `δ=τ/m` and `η=e/(2Mm)`. A certified full-H recurrence `‖e^(−iqδH)−I‖≤η` makes each physical cell an H+K_g pulse of length δ followed by an H-only wait `(q−1)δ≥0`. Telescoping gives `‖W_actual−W_ideal‖≤M[mη+τ²hc/m]≤e`. One q works for the whole word. The operator comparison holds on the full physical tensor product, including states temporarily routed onto active coordinates, and hence gives complete trace error at most 2e with arbitrary passive reference and entangled dirty transit. It does not assert exact intermediate return under the approximate implementation.

The recurrence retains the entire literal identity coefficient, including `688λ`, occupation averages and the multiplicity-two zero electric level. With `D=2^1344`, `Q=ceil(32√D/η)` and `q≤Q^D`, the supplied effective coefficient oracle, finite rational Hermitian approximation and exact Taylor/Frobenius certificate give a halting finite search with strict margins. No eigenvalue gap or exact-equality oracle is required. This algorithm was **not executed on the literal model**. Rational-operation counts do not include bit growth or coefficient-oracle runtime. Control-on time is Mτ; elapsed time is `Mqτ≤MτQ^D`; there are Mm pulses and Mm declared waits. These costs can be extraordinarily large.

The neutral target is the accepted actual 871249-primitive word and needs its supplied 1344-qubit active product input. The binary target is the accepted actual 29489403-primitive word, needs 2309 clean work/flag factors, and retains both unnormalized outputs `{P_KρP_K,(I−P_K)ρ(I−P_K)}` with within-fiber coherence and complete fine-work uncompute. K is the full accepted L4 zero space, not the fixed neutral ray. The known combined count 30360652 and incidence bound 927159 are safe sums, not a newly emitted combined word. The two preserved physical-word gzip files were not decompressed or replayed for this assembly.

The end-to-end error keeps supplied initialization and readout separate. Static calibration is charged over actual elapsed time, control error over nominal control-on time, and segment-time error under the actual supported norm premise. A fixed nonzero calibration floor is not made harmless by recurrence. Support-preserving tolerances maintain the declared whole-term cap; a small global norm discrepancy alone is insufficient for that support claim. The optional known-duration factorized flag read can be followed by another positive recurrence wait, but its apparatus, duration, support and norm are separate supplies. Unknown/nonfactorized readout remains in its complete error contract. The control cap does not price an unspecified readout device.

There are exactly four mathematical parents. Their complete unchanged relevant primary bodies are copied and uniquely located inside the current canonical notes by `PARENT_BODY_MAP.json`; full canonical wrappers are preserved as source references, not reproduced inside this candidate.

| Parent | Canonical SHA-256 | Complete primary body and role |
|---|---|---|

| [finite penalty](FINITE_GAUSS_PENALTY_RECOVERY_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | `437f2f4e94aa93038173cd138c5f6b9ad4ebdc4fbc7416428cfa13192c9e4ff4` | `bb2817d3ac9a2f986dd1abcd423331214195f4f627601949f74ca75af669bc14`: literal full penalty/raw B, whole-space norms and scalar. Its initial-K approximation is not applied during off-code controls. |
| [neutral preparation](FIXED_NEUTRAL_RAY_PREPARATION_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | `e0ea48d319165e3d310a928c437fb546f2c5ffb7de744f59609daf734ac74ec5` | `0e002497bfa624ceb116059e092b3d853c36a969f37e96794675de3e3f587124`: exact neutral target word, ordinary routing and supplied product input. |
| [binary admission](COHERENT_BINARY_K_ADMISSION_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md) | `25dfca56ca924e4ee8c42a69a755d2d073c47f720a0558276059f9d58f865281` | `8abf93c718c691f2140ae9df990bdf0b49f5ddd4a013277f36b04d3dac1887d3`: exact coherent binary word, both branches, clean-work uncompute and arbitrary-transit identity. |

[Genoni et al.'s compact-recurrence/inverse-time discussion](https://arxiv.org/abs/1110.5584v2) is prior-art attribution only; its oscillator theorem is not imported. Historical always-on V1, C870, C883, C232, read/reset-cadence and route-survey material remain context, not mathematical parents. Neither branch ancestry nor the separately developing autonomous-clock bridge adds a dependency. The proposed publication graph has exactly four direct mathematical edges. No graph or canonical surface has been changed by this source preparer.

The evidence archive preserves all 39 author files and 106 separate-review files, 27 author input pins, the full root evidence and both actual root binder attempts. The author ran one selected eight-dimensional floating routed-word control. The separate reviewer ran a four-dimensional exact rational certificate fixture, followed by a Fraction-only guard of its saved artifacts. Those are not two independent constructions. The first fixture's redundant final floating sanity guard and the exact guard qualification remain intact. Literal q=113 and scalar-subtracted q=25 were accepted in that selected fixture; literal q=25 was rejected, with a certified actual operator residual strictly greater than 189/128. None of these values is a literal-model recurrence certificate.

Review independence is limited to separately reasoned, source-exposed assessments in the same model family. Preassessment seals precede their respective first body reads, but shared architecture and earlier source exposure remain disclosed. Root's first binder failed on `utc` versus `utc_before_first_body_read`; the exact failed source, one-key diff, traceback and both outer receipts are preserved. Those receipts bind argv, recorder and streams but contain no executed-source hash; this assembly invents none. The author's original metadata-probe stream was unavailable and its archived reconstruction remains labelled a reproduction. Search-display truncation does not imply all saved hits were read.

The remaining supplied interfaces are effective knowledge of the fixed coefficients, supported phase-exact controls with positive norm margin, an external control clock and switching/calibration, clean initialization, isolation, and the actual terminal instrument. No native or autonomous control, physical positive energy/fuel, practical efficiency, unknown-background arbitrary-accuracy guarantee, all-volume result, photon/continuum interpretation or stable storage follows. This assembly changes no mathematical sentence and executes no scientific predicate. Its source-only wrapper and byte/procedure closure were accepted at the pins above; the new publication rendering, driver and canonical execution still require separate exact root acceptance.
